{{Top|leg}}
The '''H4-5D Heavy Labor Droid''' was a massive model of labor [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. A modified H4-5D was used on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], operated by [[X0-X1]] to attack a group of its enemies at the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]].
